links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of LLM responses to periodontal patient questions
links.effect: FKGL differed by model (p=0.007); ChatGPT-4o 11.18 ± 1.55, DeepSeek-R1 9.84 ± 1.78, Gemini 9.91 ± 1.89. FRE scores 42.37-49.55, all in the "difficult" range.
links.quote: All evaluated LLMs produced responses with mean QAMAI scores at the lower end of the predefined good-quality range; however, their readability exceeded recommended standards for public health materials.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM patient-directed responses versus recommended standards
links.effect: Mean FKGL ranged from 9.84 to 11.18 grade levels; FRE 42.37-49.55 ("difficult"), exceeding recommended public health material standards.
links.quote: All evaluated LLMs produced responses with mean QAMAI scores at the lower end of the predefined good-quality range; however, their readability exceeded recommended standards for public health materials.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and accuracy/quality of three commercial LLMs answering real-world patient questions on periodontology without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
